intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Williamsburg for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Christmas Town at Busch Gardens Williamsburg) through January 3, 2027, with Black Friday Kids' Day Out (November 27), Merchants Square Tree Lighting (November 28), Grand Illumination at Colonial Williamsburg (December 5, 12 and 19) and the Williamsburg Christmas Parade (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Williamsburg

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Williamsburg
  • 2 free events, including the Williamsburg Christmas Parade and 3D Pen Gingerbread Houses
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Workshop at Christmas Town and Santa photo ops every day at the Williamsburg Christmas Market
  • Parades and tree lightings: Williamsburg Christmas Parade on December 6, Merchants Square Tree Lighting on November 28 and Grand Illumination in Colonial Williamsburg
  • Trains: train rides at the Williamsburg Christmas Market and the Christmas Town Express at Busch Gardens
  • Lights: more than ten million lights at Christmas Town
  • Season: November 26, 2026 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Williamsburg families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers holiday lights and events around the Oceanfront, Town Center and the Virginia Aquarium.
